event_properties.content: How am I doing on Google vs Zomato?

On **Google**, your average is 4.1 ★ with 234 reviews this month. On **Zomato**, 3.6 ★ with 189 reviews. The gap is mainly driven by delivery experience complaints on Zomato — dine-in customers (Google) tend to rate higher.
